# The engine's `idempotency-customer-statements-v1` route set (U-140, P22
# plan §2.6): statement runs, statement email and email-later,
# `x-idempotency: true` in its openapi.json. Client-declared until the pin
# has it. Append-only for this capability name:
# `keyable-customer-statements` in operations.txt
# (`KeySet::CustomerStatementsV1`), keyed only while the engine advertises
# `idempotency-customer-statements-v1`.
POST /api/v1/customer-statement-runs
POST /api/v1/customer-statements/{id}/email
POST /api/v1/customer-statements/{id}/email-later
